system.description:
FOLKWARDEN ENCHANTMENT UTILITY
Folkwarden Specialist Spell
Cast 1 AP (verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 willing creature
Duration Until the end of the target's next turn

A familiar saying, practical instruction or fragment of inherited wisdom settles the target's nerves and focuses their attention upon the task at hand.
Choose Crafting, Medicine, Nature or Survival.
The target gains a +2-status bonus to the next check it makes using the selected skill before the spell ends.
The spell ends after applying its bonus once.

Warping Options:
+1 PP: Target one additional willing creature. All targets receive the same selected skill.
+2 PP: Select two eligible skills. The spell still ends after benefiting one check.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. Choose Crafting, Medicine, Nature or Survival: +2 status on the target's next check with it — an offered row, removed once used.
